transcript.text: Hello everyone. I'm Mara, the Plant Safety Officer. I understand we're here to discuss the hot-work permit for the welded shaft repair on the process mixer in the solvent-mixing room, scheduled for Thursday, June 12, 2025. Before I can issue a permit decision, I'll need to see the maintenance, facilities, and production reports submitted in that order and entered into the permit record, as our routine requires. Who would like to start with the maintenance report?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'm Victor, Maintenance Lead. Here's the maintenance assessment for the process mixer shaft repair: the repair will require exactly 3 hours of welding, and four electrical and pneumatic energy-isolation points must be locked and tagged. I've recorded this in a draft work order that has not yet been routed to Mara. I'm submitting this now as the maintenance report for the permit record.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'm Priya, Facilities Engineer. Here's my facilities report for the permit record: My solvent-vapor test found 18% of the lower explosive limit in the solvent-mixing room after the normal purge. Our site rule requires below 10% before hot work, so exactly 2 additional hours of exhaust ventilation and a repeat gas test are required before welding can begin. I received the laboratory result this morning but had not yet filed it in the permit system — I'm submitting this now as the facilities report for the permit record.
transcript.speaker: A3
